title: Inlet Box Position Trainer
description: Eight installations, drawn from the drive side, from the inlet side or described in text, ask for the inlet box position; resolved items show the drive-side dial, inlet-side pictures flip to the drive side, and free practice moves the box and switches viewpoints.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: inlet box
inlet box position
drive side
inlet side

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Inlet box positions read from the drive side
learningObjectives: The learner will apply the drive-side viewing convention to assign the correct inlet box position (45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315 or 360) to eight described or pictured installations, including views drawn from the inlet side.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); each item, selection, verdict, the summary and every free-practice position announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; position buttons and the view toggle are aria-pressed toggles; keys 1-8 choose, Enter checks and goes on, arrow keys turn and V switches the view in free practice; the flip animation is skipped when prefers-reduced-motion is set.

controls.label: Next installation / See score
controls.purpose: Go on after an item is resolved (Enter)

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Reset all eight items and the score

controls.label: Turn (left / right)
controls.purpose: Free practice: move the box 45 degrees (arrow keys); the box can also be dragged

equations: Drive-side position = 360 - p for an inlet-side reading p (0 written 360)
rules: Drive-side view: the position is the dial angle of the opening, clockwise from the top, with the top written 360
A text-only item is judged by where the opening must be for the stated air path
assumptions: Installations are illustrative; the housing outlet is drawn clear of the box and its rotation is not shown, because position does not depend on rotation

sources: Source: FanPedia p. 144 (Inlet Box Position Descriptions; Inlet Box Positions Determined from Drive Side), retrieved 2026-10-08

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Apply one rule to new cases, mixing drive-side and inlet-side views so the mirror step must be applied
keyQuestions: Which side is this picture drawn from?
Why do 180 and 360 read the same from both sides?
commonMisconceptions: The position can be read from whichever side the viewer stands on
Position 180 means the box faces up because air moves upward
assessmentOpportunities: Running score 'Positions correct: n of 8' counts first-attempt answers; mastery is 7 of 8.
